name: Sales Performance Report
query:
SELECT 
    o.custom_sales_person AS "Salesperson:Link/Sales Person:120",
    o.name AS "Opportunity:Link/Opportunity:120",
    o.party_name AS "Customer:Link/Customer:120",  
    o.transaction_date AS "Transaction Date:Date:120",
    o.status AS "Status:Data:120",
    o.opportunity_amount AS "Opportunity Amount:Currency:120",
    CASE 
        WHEN o.status = 'Converted' THEN 'Complete'
        WHEN o.status = 'Lost' THEN 'Missed Opportunity'
        WHEN o.status = 'Frozen' THEN 'Freeze'
        ELSE 'Pending'
    END AS "Performance Category:Data:120"
FROM `tabOpportunity` o
WHERE o.custom_sales_person = (SELECT employee_name FROM `tabEmployee` WHERE user_id = %(user)s)
ORDER BY o.transaction_date DESC;
